blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo integrar leitura, escuta, fala e escrita em uma entrevista sobre liderança em negociações e usar step up.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: A veteran negotiator talks about leading under pressure.
qa: Interviewer: When did you first lead a team?
**Young as I was**, I had to **step up** when my manager fell ill. **Having never run** a negotiation, I **set** one rule: listen first. **Despite** my nerves, the team followed.
Interviewer: What advice do you give?

**Step up** early, but **step down** when the job is done. Remember that every long negotiation, **however tiring**, **gives rise to** trust if you stay honest. By next year I **will have been mentoring** young negotiators for a decade, and I **would not have done** it differently.

items.q: The negotiator led a team before she was young.
She will have been mentoring for a decade by next year.

blocks.body: **step up** (assumir mais responsabilidade; intensificar) é **inseparável** quando intransitivo (*She stepped up*); com objeto: *step up efforts / step efforts up*.

items.s: When my manager fell ill, I had to ___ up. (step)
___ as I was, I led the team. (Young)
Step up early, but step ___ when the job is done. (down)
By next year I will have ___ mentoring for a decade. (be)

body: **Rise to the occasion** — Estar à altura da ocasião
**Take the lead** — Assumir a liderança
**Pull one’s weight** — Fazer a sua parte
**Learn the ropes** — Aprender o ofício
**Lead from the front** — Liderar pelo exemplo
**Shoulder the responsibility** — Assumir a responsabilidade
**Pass the torch** — Passar o bastão
**Call it a day** — Encerrar por hoje
**How did you become a leader?** — Como você se tornou líder?
**And when should I step down?** — E quando devo deixar o cargo?
**When the job is done and someone else is ready.** — Quando o trabalho estiver feito e outra pessoa estiver pronta.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence reflection about a time you stepped up, using step up, a concessive and will have been -ing.
blocks.model: Nervous as I was, I stepped up when our leader left. Having never run a meeting, I set one rule: listen first. Despite my doubts, the team followed. The experience gave rise to real trust. By next year I will have been leading the group for three years. I would not have done it differently. However hard it was, it changed me.

items.why: **first leadership role** = primeira função de liderança.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
